description: This file defines an abstract class 'SoftRefCacheLine' that extends 'CacheLine'. It manages cache entries using soft references, allowing for garbage collection of cache values when memory is low. The class provides methods to retrieve the value and cancel the cache line, which clears the reference.

classes.name: SoftRefCacheLine
classes.description: An abstract class managing cache lines with soft references to allow garbage collection under memory pressure. It extends CacheLine and encapsulates a CacheSoftReference to the cached value.

methods.name: SoftRefCacheLine
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cache line with a value, load time, and expiration time, and wrapping the value in a CacheSoftReference.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Clears the soft reference, effectively invalidating the cache line.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the cached value from the soft reference.
